title: fix(metadata-protocol): a metadata save's audit row names the user who saved it
body:
Fixes #27539
Part of #27414

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:元数据保存(`/meta`、`/automation`、删除)写 `sys_audit_log` 时,审计行的 `user_id` / `actor` 现在记下保存人,不再是空。
- 为什么改:ADR-0073 D3 要求归属必须具体;此前管理员每次保存元数据,审计日志都显示"无人"。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `SysMetadataRepository.put` / `delete` 写入时带的上下文,权限判定仍按系统身份;回滚即还原本 PR 一个文件。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts` 的 `writeContext` 两处(put 与 delete)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/sys-metadata-repository.recorded-by.test.ts`,预期 15/15 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`SysMetadataRepository.put` and `delete` ran every `sys_metadata` / `sys_metadata_history` write under `{ ...ctx, isSystem: true }`. That context carries no `session.userId` and no `attributedUserId`, the only two sources the audit writer (`plugin-audit` `audit-writers.ts`) reads for `sys_audit_log.user_id`. So every metadata save's audit row named nobody, on every door, `/meta` included, even though the save's `actor` already reached `created_by` / `updated_by` / `recorded_by`.

Both verbs now build one `writeContext` per transaction: `isSystem: true` as before, plus `attributedUserId: opts.actor` when the save names an actor. `attributedUserId` is the existing attribution channel (`ExecutionContext.attributedUserId`, copied by the engine into `HookContext.provenance.attributedUserId`). The write is still authorized as the system, and the actor is never placed in `userId`, so no caller-gating hook reads it as the caller. With no actor the key is absent, so engine self-writes and seeds stay unattributed, as before. Reads are unchanged. No new mechanism, no spec change.

## Tests

- New pins in `sys-metadata-repository.recorded-by.test.ts` (the file's existing engine double now records each write verb's context; no new double):
  - actor case: create, update and delete with three different actors. Every write (`sys_metadata` insert/update/delete plus the history insert) carries `isSystem: true`, `attributedUserId` set to that write's actor, and no `userId`.
  - control: with no actor, all six writes carry `isSystem: true` and no `attributedUserId` key.
- A real-store pin with the audit writer installed cannot live in this package. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` has no driver, objectql or plugin-audit dependency, and objectql depends on this package, so importing it would create a cycle. The engine-to-audit-writer leg was measured end to end instead (Verification below).

<details><summary>Package suite and typecheck at 9bc0b58490</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 279 passed, 4 skipped (283). Tests 21783 passed, 26 skipped.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (fix committed first, src import so no rebuild needed)</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` removed the `attributedUserId` spread from `put`'s `writeContext`. Anchor 1 -> 0, blob 5b8de92d7583 -> 3ee7c3a8b2eb. Result: 1 failed, 14 passed. The failure was the actor pin; the control stayed green. Restore: blob == HEAD 5b8de92d7583, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The `/automation` doors pass no `actor` until #27538 lands. Before that PR, their audit rows stay null for the same reason their `created_by` does.
- `pnpm check:system-context-census` passes with no register edit. The change spreads `isSystem: true` exactly as before, and the census does not count that as a new elevation read site.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live, stock showcase, fresh DB, signed in as the seeded admin</summary>

Branch build at this PR's head, plus #27538's one-file runtime change applied locally and not committed. I read `GET /api/v1/data/sys_audit_log` filtered to `object_name = sys_metadata`. Every door answered 200:

- `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/qa_meta_27539` gave a create row with `user_id` and `actor` set to the admin id.
- `POST /api/v1/automation` gave a create row with `user_id` and `actor` set to the admin id.
- `PUT /api/v1/automation/qa_auto_27539` gave an update row with `user_id` and `actor` set to the admin id.
- `DELETE /api/v1/meta/flow/qa_meta_27539` gave a delete row with `user_id` and `actor` set to the admin id.

Earlier run without #27538's change: the `/meta` create and delete rows held the admin id. The `POST /api/v1/automation` create row had `user_id` null and `actor` null. That door passes no actor yet, so this is the no-actor control.
</details>
